isla-red.$description: Isla Red — Primary action buttons, critical links, brand accents, small heading underlines. It provides a confident punctuation to the otherwise neutral palette

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — Primary text, core borders, header elements. It grounds the design with strong contrast

ink-grey.$description: Ink Grey — Secondary text, subheadings, badge text, and deeper neutral components. Offers a softer alternative to Pure Black for text

cream-canvas.$description: Cream Canvas — Dominant page background, soft card backgrounds, and subtle badges. Establishes the light, welcoming tone

white-surface.$description: White Surface — Main card backgrounds, elevated sections, and button text when paired with Isla Red. Provides bright contrast

deep-grey.$description: Deep Grey — Muted text in navigation and other secondary UI elements. Darker than Ink Grey, yet lighter than Pure Black, providing a specific hierarchy

warm-grey-border.$description: Warm Grey Border — Subtle borders on ghost buttons and delicate dividing lines. Adds texture without strong visual weight

muted-text-grey.$description: Muted Text Grey — Fine print, helper text, and secondary badge text where readability is paramount but visual hierarchy needs to be lower than primary text

stone-grey.$description: Stone Grey — Tertiary text, descriptive labels, and badge text when a warmer, softer tone is needed

minimal-border-grey.$description: Minimal Border Grey — Dark borders and separators for elevated surfaces and inverted UI. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

soft-peach.$description: Soft Peach — Subtle background for informational badges or highlight areas. Adds a touch of warmth to the neutral palette

soehne-buch.$description: Standard body text, navigation links, and smaller UI elements. Its clean, readable nature handles the bulk of informational content.

nimbus-sans.$description: Headlines, product titles, and key UI elements requiring precise tracking and strong hierarchy. The varied weights and condensed letter spacing create a modern, efficient voice.

soehne-kraftig.$description: Brand elements and impactful statements, using a more robust sans-serif character. The tighter tracking for larger sizes reinforces a sense of directness.

agaramondpro.$description: Elegant, editorial headings and block quotes. The subtle negative letter spacing at this weight gives a refined, composed feel.

eb-garamond.$description: Refined secondary headings and descriptive text, adding an approachable, classic touch.

garamond-italic.$description: Emphasized body copy, subtle quotes, and small contextual asides. The slight positive tracking ensures legibility at smaller italic sizes alongside the serifs.
